prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2D moon illustration for the night sky of a charming hand-painted anime fantasy JRPG.
Primary request: one enormous, beautiful FULL MOON, a complete round lunar disc painted by hand. Soft luminous ivory, pale buttercream and pearl tones, subtle lavender-blue lunar seas and a few broad softly brushed craters. Elegant gouache and watercolor brush texture, gentle animated-film background illustration in the spirit of Ghibli countryside skies. Clearly an illustrated drawing, with tasteful simplified shapes and painterly depth.
Composition: the single full circular moon centered, nearly filling a square canvas, a small clean transparent margin on all sides. Keep it circular and uncropped. Calm, softly uneven painted edge; enough surface detail to look lovely at 320 pixels in a 1080p game.
Lighting: softly self-luminous, gentle tonal variation across the disc, no dramatic side shadow.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha outside the disc; no sky, clouds, stars, landscapes, other objects, frames, text or watermark. No face, eyes or smile. No crescent, no cutout bite, no photorealistic NASA texture, no 3D render, no large baked glow halo; the game adds a subtle glow separately.
usage: Transparent painting replacing the geometric crescent; original preserved, cached with runtime cropping and mipmaps.
